# icon-layers-style-colour (yellow style)

The icon split into parts, in the style's lettering colour. Same canvas size for every file: stack them and they line up exactly. `holes/` has each sprocket hole on its own, for animating them one by one.

## Folders

| Folder | What is in it |
|---|---|
| [`holes/`](holes/) | Each sprocket hole of the film strip on its own transparent layer (same canvas as the other layers), numbered from the bottom. |
